sections.shortTitle: The Punjab Shops and Establishments Security Act 1999
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PUNJAB SHOPS AND ESTABLISHMENTS (SECURITY) ACT, 1999
PUNJAB
SHOPS AND ESTABLISHMENTS (SECURITY) ACT, 1999
(ACT NO. II OF
1999)
[4th February, 1999]
An Act to provide
for the Security of Shops and Establishments
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Punjab Shops and Establishments
(Security) Act, 1999.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: The Punjab Shops and Establishments Security Act 1999
sections.description:
Security of Establishments

PUNJAB SHOPS AND ESTABLISHMENTS (SECURITY) ACT, 1999
PUNJAB
SHOPS AND ESTABLISHMENTS (SECURITY) ACT, 1999
(ACT NO. II OF
1999)
[4th February, 1999]
An Act to provide
for the Security of Shops and Establishments
2. Security of Establishments.--The
Government may by order provided for the regulation of and enforcement of
measures for the security of the property and personal connected with an
Establishment.
Explanation.--In
this Act 'Establishment' includes:-
(i) a bank, a money changer or a
financial institution; and
(ii) any office, firm, company, institution, industrial unit,
undertaking, shop or premises which undertakes any business, trade, manufacture
calling service employment or occupation.

3. Penalties.--If any
person contravenes any order made under this Act he shall be punished with
imprisonment which may extend to one month or with fine which may extend to
fifteen thousand rupees or with both and if the offence continues the
establishment may be kept sealed till such time the order is compiled with.
